name: Bokeh
author: Erin Carter
description: A city seen through a fast lens at night: three depth layers of out-of-focus heptagonal light discs drift sideways with parallax and blink like distant signage, each tinted a palette hue and rimmed with the bright iris of a defocused camera.

params.label: Disc size
params.effect: Base diameter (css px) of the near-layer aperture discs; other layers scale proportionally, from tight distant lights to huge soft foreground circles.

params.label: Drift
params.effect: Overall sideways drift speed of the disc field; 0 hangs the lights motionless, high values pan the whole city past.

params.label: Parallax
params.effect: Speed spread between depth layers; 0 moves all layers as one flat sheet, 1 makes the near layer race past nearly static distant lights.

params.label: Blink rate
params.effect: How frequently individual discs flicker and switch like far-off signage; 0 leaves every light steady.
